parsed.text: This packet contains two panels (p0 and p1). Each panel gives current distributions and conditional command (k0,k1,k2) candidate distributions at nodes n0–n3 for red and blue on a 4×4 grid (rows downward, columns rightward). Copied prior records are presented as inherited current values and are not new estimates; native conditional records are conditional forecasts, not executed events. Current (both panels): n0 — blue mass concentrated on the top-right 2×2 block (cells [0,2],[0,3],[1,2],[1,3]); red mass concentrated on the top-left 2×2 block ([0,0],[0,1],[1,0],[1,1]). n1 and n2 — uniform distributions across all 16 cells for both roles. n3 — blue peak at [1,1]; red peak at [0,2]. Conditional command records change the n0 and n0-related estimates across panels and commands: some candidate records (e.g. several k0/k1/k2 entries) collapse blue and red to single-cell peaks at [0,2] (blue) and [0,0] (red) with higher peak probabilities, while other conditional records (and the current view in p1) keep the broader 2×2 pattern at n0. Other nodes remain uniform or retain the same single-cell peaks shown in current. No propositions here assert physical presence or event occurrence; these are descriptions of the supplied distributions and their peak cells.
